description: Three-node closed-loop comparison: existing handlers versus program handlers with lazy resolved-change endpoints.
limits: Two balanced pairs per workload; not a confidence bound.
Three outstanding transactions; not maximum saturated throughput.
Confirmation ends at API observation, before any required durable disk flush.
No concurrent builds or tests during measured runs.
Preliminary Cabal runs and concurrent-build smoke test excluded.
